exposure: obesity status (non-obese vs. obese) in GDM patients
cohort: The study evaluated 400 pregnant women diagnosed with gestational diabetes mellitus (GDM), comprising 200 non-obese and 200 obese participants.
finding: Obese GDM patients demonstrated significantly elevated risks of preeclampsia, cesarean delivery, macrosomia, and neonatal intensive care unit admission, with elevated BMI and higher glycated hemoglobin levels identified as independent risk factors for adverse outcomes.
mod_finding: The obese GDM group demonstrated significantly elevated risks of cesarean delivery.
